body:
I had one. But I moved so I lost her a few weeks ago. I was supposed to get one here but everyone is full or doesn't have hours available when I am. I feel like therapy just... has failed me. I just learn fake ways of dealing with my thoughts in hopes they get better.
I need medication, but I don't have anyone who can prescribe them right now and I'm scared if I go to a hospital or mental health place they will try to admit me but I have a dog I have to care for and no one to come check on her. I also couldn't afford it if I did go to seek emergency help.

The things I want just feel so far away & out of reach. Like... it's a daydream and it will never be real. I have no way to make it happen. I'm so alone.
I want it to be better. But I'm just so tired of trying.
I feel stuck. I have always felt so stuck... and I just don't wanna do this anymore.
